summary: A responsive academic waste-segregation and community-monitoring web application for Dr. D.Y. Patil College of Engineering & Innovation. It uses honest demo mode until a real TensorFlow/Keras inference API and Supabase credentials are configured, and must never fabricate predictions or community analytics.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: No existing application source, manifests, tests, or dependencies were present to augment.

questions.question: Describe the features for Smart Waste Segregation and Community Monitoring System.
questions.answer: Build a responsive React/TypeScript/Vite application for Dr. D.Y. Patil College of Engineering & Innovation, Varale-Talegaon, Pune, AI and Data Science Department; student team Krishna Sankeshwari and Durgesh Upasani; academic year 2026-2027. Include Home, Classify Waste, Community Dashboard, Community Survey, Report an Issue, Awareness Center, and About Project pages. Use Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Lucide, Framer Motion, Recharts, React Router, React Hook Form, and Zod. Classification supports image upload/drop, preview, validation, loading, result/manual correction/reset, but honest DEMO MODE must never invent predictions or confidence; expose a modular TensorFlow/Keras API adapter and display safety warnings for hazardous, biomedical, chemical, sanitary, electronic, and unidentified dangerous waste. Dashboard charts must use genuine records only and clearly label any supplied sample data DEMO DATA. Implement anonymous validated survey submissions (eight domain questions; exact wording is not present in the existing artifacts), optional issue-image upload with consent, reference IDs/tracking only where backend support exists, awareness guidance with local-rule caveats, and project/technology/limitations information. Prepare Supabase PostgreSQL migrations, RLS, and optional Supabase Storage; no privileged keys in browser code. Without credentials, keep backend-dependent features visibly unconfigured and provide usable empty/demo states. Respect reduced motion, accessibility, responsive layouts, and theme preferences. Never claim an unconfigured model or backend is operational.
questions.rationale: The user supplied the complete updated application scope. Existing artifacts did not contain exact survey question wording, so the eight-item survey will need a domain-appropriate definition during implementation.

questions.question: Which data stores does your app need?
questions.rationale: The user explicitly requested Supabase PostgreSQL, database migrations, RLS, and optional image storage. Blob Storage records the file/object-storage requirement; the implementation provider must remain Supabase Storage as requested, not Azure Blob Storage.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist data or use storage, queues, or caches.
